sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Remarketing of Secondhand Hydraulic Earthmovers and Rollers

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with Common Law influences in corporate and maritime law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 27 April 2015, as amended by Law 70 of 2017 and Executive Decrees 360 of 2015 and 152 of 2022; Law 52 of 2016 on the beneficial owner registry (Registro de Titulares de Beneficiarios); Código de Comercio (Articles 68-70); Resolución No. 54 of 2015 of the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) on AML/CFT obligations for resident agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (if the incorporator signs on behalf of shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention countries

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Certificate of Good Standing (for any corporate shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter covering the UBO's source of wealth (obtained from the UBO's bank)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent or reference bank of the UBO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) for all politically exposed persons (PEPs) as defined by Law 23 of 2015 (family members and close associates included). The licensed resident agent must screen UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the FATF black and grey lists, and Panama's UAF lists of persons linked to money laundering or terrorist financing. Screening must be updated continuously; individual risk profiles must be documented and retained for five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá Digital (RPP Web) – online name reservation platform provided by the Public Registry of Panama
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name may be expressed in Latin-script Spanish or English (or another Latin-script language), but statutory Articles of Incorporation and all ancillary filings must be in Spanish. Names in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet. The name must be distinctive, not identical or deceptively similar to any registered entity, and must not contain terms implying governmental, banking, fiduciary, or public-interest activity without ministerial or supervisory authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or authorized resident agent may file a 'Recurso de Reconsideración' (reconsideration petition) with the Public Registry within five business days of the notification date. If denied, the petitioner may lodge a 'Recurso de Apelación' (administrative appeal) before the Director General of the Public Registry within ten business days of the denial, accompanied by the previously submitted supporting documentation and any additional evidence distinguishing the proposed name. The procedural framework is governed by the Ley 18 de 2018 (Public Registry reform) and the Administrative Procedure Law (Ley 38 de 2000).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a non-financial S.A. engaged in wholesaling of used construction equipment. The Companies Act (Ley General de Sociedades) requires only a registered agent domiciled in Panama who maintains a physical address and accepts service of process on behalf of the corporation. A virtual office or serviced registered-agent address fully satisfies the statutory requirement; there is no need for a physical operational office in Panama unless the company applies for special permits (e.g., customs bonded storage) or conducts physical business activities in-country.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <5% unannounced on-site physical inspection risk for a registered agent-held office of a non-licensed wholesaling entity). The resident agent's premises may be subject to compliance inspection by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) on AML/CFT record-keeping and resident-agent obligations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial execution of the Articles of Incorporation (Escritura Pública)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary of the Circuito Notarial of Panama

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the company with the Panama Public Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff based on authorized share capital (US$10,000 standard)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year resident agent services (retainer of licensed attorney/registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (Panama Bar Association range)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified copies of the registered articles and Certificate of Good Standing
Hague Apostille / consular legalization process and courier handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Cancillería de Panamá) or consulate / courier service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory public fee plus market benchmark courier cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register disclosure filing (submission of beneficial owner declaration to the Dirección General de Ingresos)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual filing fee per Law 52 of 2016

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC professional due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, and risk file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm / compliance officer of the resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing fixed professional fee per client onboarding

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Panama General Corporation Law), as amended by Ley No. 5 de 2016 (electronic inscription) and Ley No. 254 de 2021 (beneficial ownership registry); core provisions on formation (arts. 1 et seq.), registered office and resident agent (arts. 21 et seq.), and directors and officers (arts. 56 et seq.); procedural filing rules per the Reglamento y Tarifas del Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Entities Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos (Escritura Pública de Constitución) — protocolized by a Panamanian notary and inscribed in the Registro Público; the Registry thereafter issues the Certificado de Personería Jurídica (Certificate of Legal Existence).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-in capital applies under Ley 32 de 1927; the articles must state an authorized capital (customarily USD 10,000) and the share classes. Shares may be subscribed without escrow or bank certification; incorporation may proceed with zero paid-in capital, and no capital duty or escrow account is mandated by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE FOUNDING DIRECTOR(S) OF [PA_CORP], S.A. The undersigned founder-director, acting under Law 32 of 1927 and the registered Pacto Social, resolves: 1. The subscriptions to 10,000 common shares, par value USD 1.00 each, are accepted, issued fully paid, and recorded in the Share Register as fully paid-up. 2. The registered office is fixed at [Address, Calle 50, Panama City], and [Resident Agent Firm] is engaged as resident agent. 3. [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each with the powers stated in Article [24] of the Statutes. 4. The officers are authorized to file the annual franchise tax, open bank accounts, and execute clearing and trading documents. Certified: [Signature], Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Departamento de Nombres de Personas Jurídicas (online via the licensed resident agent's certified portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the 'Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre' listing three candidate names in descending preference; pay the B/. 15.00 search fee; the Registry prints the 'Certificado de Búsqueda' reserving the approved name for 30 business days.
required_dossiers: Copy of incorporator's passport or national ID
Power of attorney granted to the resident agent (if execution is by agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registrant, the next alternative is automatically considered; refile a new search with additional candidates. An expired reservation is cured by re-submission and payment of a new search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Pacto Social (Articles of Incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (any licensed Panamanian notary) acting together with the licensed resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporating attorney drafts the Escritura de Constitución containing the corporate name, authorized capital, share classes, registered office, resident agent, first directors, and corporate purpose; the incorporator(s) appear personally or execute by power of attorney; the notary protocolizes the instrument as Escritura Pública No. ___ and issues a certified 'Primera Copia' for registration.
required_dossiers: Passport or ID of each incorporator
Power of attorney (if execution is by agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect in the deed is cured by an 'Acta de Corrección' or 'Ratificación' signed before the same notary without a new name search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Payment of Fees at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Ventanilla de Inscripción / e-filing 'Registro en Línea')
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified first copy of the deed together with the 'Solicitud de Inscripción'; pay the 'Derecho de Inscripción' of B/. 175.00 (authorized capital up to USD 10,000.00) or B/. 275.00 (capital up to USD 100,000.00); elect ordinary inscription (approximately 5 business days) or the urgent 'servicio urgente' for a 48-hour turnaround.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the notarial deed
Official payment receipt issued by the registry cashier or authorized bank
Solicitud de Inscripción signed by the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the formality review issues an 'observación' or 'reparo', the resident agent files a written clarification or a supplementary note through the same submission window; minor drafting defects are cured without additional registry fee, while substantive capital changes require a separate 'Reforma de Estatutos' registered as a new deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Personería Jurídica, Tax ID (RUC), and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (certificates) and Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — Ventanilla Única / online tax portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, request the 'Certificado de Personería Jurídica' and exact copies; register the corporation at the DGI for the 11-digit RUC (taxpayer number); file the 'Aviso de Operación' (Formulario 001) with activity code CIIU 4659; obtain the 'Certificado de Registro de Operación' before issuing invoices or executing import/export documents.
required_dossiers: Passports or national IDs of officers
Registered office lease or ownership title
Utility bill evidencing the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI rejects the Aviso de Operación due to a CIIU code mismatch, correct the 'actividad económica' field in the electronic DGI portal and resubmit Formulario 001; an inactive RUC is cured by presenting the personería and filing the corresponding sworn tax registration statement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Books and Beneficial Ownership Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent (internal corporate books) and Dirección General de Ingresos (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales, Ley 254 de 2021)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Approve the Share Register, Board Minutes Book, and General Ledger (maintained by the resident agent or a certified public accountant); file the declaration of ultimate beneficial owners with the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry stating the shareholding percentages of each natural person; update the file within 30 days of any ownership change and pay the annual 'Tasa Única' franchise tax of B/. 300.00 by each July 31 following incorporation.
required_dossiers: List of shareholders and supporting identity documents
Corporate books (Share Register, Minutes Book, General Ledger)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late submission of the beneficial ownership declaration is cured by electronic filing with the statutory surcharge before the DGI; sustained default triggers statutory fines and possible suspension of corporate filings, remedied by payment of the penalty and submission of the updated declaration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — no industrial or manufacturing license applies to pure wholesale remarketing of used construction machinery (ISIC 4659); the activity is governed by the DGI tax registration, the municipal Aviso de Operación, and the environmental/fire clearances listed below.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating license required; the legal prerequisites for physical operation are (i) the DGI 'Certificado de Registro de Operación' (RUC and Aviso de Operación), (ii) the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' / commercial license from the Municipality of Panama, and (iii) the fire-safety certificate described below.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (no EIA study required) — covered warehousing and remarketing of used machinery without disassembly, degreasing, painting, or parts processing falls outside the positive lists requiring a Categoría I or II EIA under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 123 de 2020 and Ley 41 de 1998; the operator may file a voluntary environmental registration if the warehouse is located near protected areas or water bodies.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process effluent is generated in pure trading operations. For sanitary wastewater from office/warehouse facilities, comply with the MiAMBIENTE/IDAAN liquid discharge parameter tables: pH 6.0–9.0, BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L, and oil & grease ≤ 20 mg/L. Stormwater runoff from the machinery storage yard must pass through a three-chamber oil/grit separator; drained hydraulic fluids and used oils must be transported and disposed of by a MiAMBIENTE-registered hazardous waste hauler with a manifest log retained for 5 years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and annual certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering extinguishers, emergency exits, and electrical installations; municipal structural load and building-use clearance issued by the Dirección de Obras y Construcción of the Municipality of Panama for the warehouse, storage racks, and any mezzanine; and the occupational health and safety plan ('Plan de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo') filed with the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) covering forklift operators and material-handling personnel, with annual renewal.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — the Panamanian banking regulator; Panama has no central bank. U.S. dollar is legal tender under the Monetary Law (Ley 84 de 1904); foreign exchange administration is customarily supervised by SBP for banks under Decree Law 9 of 1998, as amended. There is no foreign exchange control authority or board.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized economy with full legal tender for the U.S. dollar; the balboa is a money of account only. There is no exchange control law, no capital account restrictions, and no requirement for Central Bank authorization for foreign investment, profit repatriation, or dividend remittance. Current and capital transactions are freely convertible. Profit remittances are not subject to FX restrictions, but a dividend withholding tax of 10% applies on distributions (subject to certain advanced 'dividend tax' credits under Panama's territorial tax regime). Inward direct investment and capital injections are unrestricted; only AML/KYC compliance and beneficial ownership disclosure requirements imposed by the SBP under Law 23 of 2015 (Vega Act) must be satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export proceeds surrender requirements are in place. Panama does not impose any mandatory conversion or domiciliation of export earnings in the local banking system. Exporters retain full freedom to hold export proceeds in USD or any other currency in any authorized bank. The notional surrender ratio is 0%, and the statutory timeline is N/A.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Conditional / Medium. Panama has not introduced a full 'e-money token' or digital EMI licensing framework; non-bank payment service providers may operate under the SBP's pending Fintech Law (Bill 697) but for now must either be a licensed bank, a licensed payment processor, or use a commercial agent arrangement with an authorized local bank. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., licensed by FCA, BaFin, or Banque de France) are not allowed to independently take deposits or offer payment accounts to Panamanian-domiciled companies without entering into a partnership with a Panamanian licensed bank or creating a local branch with SBP authorization. In practice, a Panamanian treasury may use an EMI as an auxiliary disbursement rail for international suppliers, but the primary corporate bank must hold legal entity funds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required for the beneficial owner and legal representative for non-resident high-risk S.A. structures; remote opening is possible only under SBP-authorized 'digital KYC' pilots, which are not commonplace for a used-machinery trading vehicle in the Medium-Risk Enhanced tier. For most tier-1 banks, the UBO and at least one director must attend an on-site interview (or, if impossible, attend by notarized power-of-attorney before a Panamanian attorney registered with the bank, but this may still be rejected). Videoconference meetings are accepted by some private banks, subject to pre-agreement with the compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity – nominee shareholder chain or bearer-share legacy (even though bearer shares are now immobilized) or lack of individual UBO identification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO declaration (Form 720) signed by each ultimate individual, notarized and apostilled; current share register (Registro de Acciones) with full chain of title; shareholder resolutions appointing legal representative; passport copies with notarial certification; references from the existing bank relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade inconsistency – invoice values for secondhand excavators deviate significantly from industry appraisal benchmarks (e.g., Kelly/Curtis Asian Machinery Market Price Guide).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-inspection third-party appraisal (CGA/AMT) with full internal/external photos, serial number, hour meter, and condition grading; authorization letter from seller to verify equipment history; transport insurance documentation; contract of sale brimming with trade terms and Incoterms; customs entry/import declaration and Bill of Lading/Airway Bill.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/end-user risk – potential diversion to sanctioned jurisdictions or military dual-use end users.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificate (E.C.) signed by the final buyer disclosing jurisdiction of use; compliance screening report against OFAC and consolidated EU/UN lists; freight forwarding passport and ports of origin/destination; statement of no re-export without authorization; OEM/manufacturer certificate if the used excavator has hydraulic or radio-controlled technology subject to export controls; legal opinion from counsel on the equipment technical parameters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth insufficient – capital injection arriving from low-tax jurisdiction or from an undocumented third party.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-clearance source of funds memorandum: audited financial statements of the shareholder (if commercial entity); bank account statements of originating bank showing prior asset accumulation; certified share subscription and capitalization resolution (Estatutos y Acta); corporate tax receipt; legal opinion on the economic substance relative to Panama territorial tax requirements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction pattern – high volume of round-trip transactions through same bank sector or advance payments to suppliers without supporting contracts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly cash-flow forecast and trade register; signed master purchase agreement with suppliers (ex-catalog); invoice selection with matching serial numbers; bank reference letters from counterparty banks; confirmation of physical logistics (port warehouse receipts) and reconciliation of clearing entries.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections into the Panamanian entity should be routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to the account in the name of the S.A. The purpose code in SWIFT field 72/77T can include 'N/A' as Panama does not mandate a central-bank purpose code; however, we recommend using the ISO 20022 'Corporate Action' code or legacy format 'CAPITAL ACCOUNT' in field 70. For loans, the transfer must reference 'Loan Agreement dated [YYYY-MM-DD]'. Verification requires: (i) a certified copy of the corporate resolution approving the capital contribution or loan; (ii) a notarized share subscription sheet; (iii) a board director certificate listing borrowing powers; (iv) a source-of-funds declaration; and (v) the bank's internal onboarding checklist signed by the compliance officer. Banco General and Towerbank ordinarily require a 'Cash Flow Front Office' interview for the first inbound transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound settlement of used equipment purchases, the company should give priority to SWIFT MT103 direct wire transfers in US dollars (since the counterparties in Japan or North America typically clear in USD or local; the Panamanian bank may operate a nostro account in that currency). For high-value single transactions exceeding USD 500,000, a documentary straight or irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by the buying bank with the Panamanian entity as beneficiary can be used to ensure proof of export title transfer. For payments to suppliers, a commercial LC through Banco General or Towerbank with a confirming bank in Japan (e.g., MUFG) reduces settlement risk. All allocations must correspond to Incoterms (EXW or FOB) and tie to the equipment list.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/JPY deliverable forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months)
Cross-currency swaps (USD vs JPY/EUR) structured as back-to-back on trade receivables
FX swaps (swap of principal and interest in USD/EUR for balance-sheet netting)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on regional Latin American currencies (USD/COP, USD/BRL, USD/MXN) for construction-equipment receivables from neighboring markets

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) - annual fee required to keep the Panamanian corporation in good standing and authorize Registry operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; compliance verified by the Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by July 15 (payment window January 1 - July 15) under Law 70 of 2019; the first annual fee is paid pro rata at incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment imposes statutory surcharges and moratory interest, blocks the issuance of Paz y Salvo certificates and the registration of share transfers/corporate acts, and failure to pay for 3 consecutive years authorizes the Public Registry to dissolve the company ex officio (administrative strike-off)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta, Form 147) - territorial tax filing covering Panama-source income from used excavator and roller wholesale trading
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance (electronic filing portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of the year following the fiscal year-end (3-month statutory term after December 31 for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous filing triggers statutory surcharges and moratory interest; the DGI may assess taxes ex officio, impose fines and embargo assets; outstanding liabilities prevent issuance of the Paz y Salvo certificate required for Registry and notarial transactions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales) - annual UBO confirmation under the anti-money-laundering beneficial ownership regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Beneficial Owners Electronic Registry (Ley 254 de 2021 and DGI regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 for the preceding calendar year; any mid-year change, including every share transfer recorded in the Register of Members, must be updated on the DGI platform within 30 days of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and surcharges under Law 254 de 2021 (aggravated breaches subject to the maximum statutory fine); withholding of solvency certificates; registered agents are authorized to file at the company's expense on non-compliance; continuous default may impair Registry transactions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit is mandatory only for regulated financial, securities, insurance or gaming licensees and for taxpayers selected by the DGI (large taxpayers or those exceeding the DGI's audited-financial-statement gross-revenue threshold, commonly USD 1,000,000); for this non-licensed used-machinery trading S.A., audit is otherwise triggered by lender or trade-counterparty covenants such as Standby LC facilities rather than by statute
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Panama (full IFRS for regulated and public-interest entities; IFRS for SMEs for private non-listed companies), with statutory books (Diary, General Ledger, Inventories and Balance Sheet books) kept per the Código de Comercio and Código Fiscal formalities and available for DGI inspection

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Pursuant to Ley 254 de 2021 and DGI regulations, the S.A. must file the annual UBO declaration by March 31 covering the prior fiscal year. The protocol requires: (i) reconciling the Register of Members against every share transfer executed during the year, including transfers settled via SWIFT LC or wire; (ii) identifying all natural persons with direct or indirect ownership of at least 10% of capital or control; (iii) updating the DGI platform within 30 days of any mid-year transfer; and (iv) obtaining the registered agent's confirmation before issuing certificates or recording Registry acts

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - 1,200 per year (resident agent and registered office inclusive of routine corporate secretarial support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 10,000 per audit engagement (only if the DGI threshold or bank/Standby LC covenant triggers an audit)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% for taxable income exceeding USD 1.5 million; lower graduated rates apply below that threshold: 15% on the first USD 200,000 of taxable income, 20% on the next USD 350,000, and 25% on the band from USD 550,001 to USD 1.5 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: foreign-source income and certain export sale proceeds are exempt from Panama income tax; for an active used-machinery trading S.A. with substantiated offshore sales, the effective rate on foreign-source trading profit can be 0%. Domestic-source trading profit is effectively burdened by the 25% headline rate plus the 10% dividend withholding tax at distribution. The Complementary Alternative Income Tax (CAIR) imposes a minimum tax of 4.67% of taxable costs of goods sold or gross taxable income for taxpayers with annual gross income over USD 1.5 million.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 730 (Declaración Anual de Renta para Personas Jurídicas), filed electronically through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) e-filing portal, Sistema T@-P-30 (https://www.dgi.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; taxpayers also make eleven equal monthly advance payments (1/12 of the prior year's final tax) during months 1 through 11 of the fiscal year, with any balance payable at filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be submitted, and the final balance paid, within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers the statutory deadline is March 31 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from sales of used construction excavators and rollers delivered or sold in Panama, including domestic resales, commissions from Panamanian buyers, and warehousing/service income realized in the territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the taxable territorial base; the non-resident-owned S.A. must include all sales where title passes or delivery occurs in Panama regardless of the residence of the buyer or seller.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1A - Exempt and foreign-source gross income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross proceeds from export sales to non-Panamanian customers where the machinery leaves Panama and the economic activity is performed abroad; also dividends and interest received from foreign sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim the territorial exemption only with documentary support: purchase orders, bills of lading, customs export declarations, and foreign bank confirmations. Unsupportable export claims are a prime audit trigger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - Cost of sales and deductible operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Acquisition cost of used excavators and rollers, import duties actually paid, freight, insurance, port storage, inspectors' fees, repairs, commissions, rent, payroll, and professional fees, all supported by invoices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be normal and necessary, properly documented, and economically connected with Panamanian-source income; payments to related foreign suppliers require transfer-pricing support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable gross receipts minus allowable deductions, before loss carryforward and before application of the minimum alternative tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A taxable loss is permissible, but sustained three-year losses with continuous distributions to shareholders will be examined for economic substance and interposed-company recharacterization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Income tax at graduated rates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 15% / 20% / 25% graduated scale to net taxable income to compute the regular income tax (ISR).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the same schedule for closely held S.A.s with non-resident shareholders; no reduced or preferential corporate rate is granted by reason of foreign ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute 4.67% of the higher of taxable costs of goods sold or gross taxable income; declare the CAIR where it exceeds the regular ISR, for taxpayers with gross income above USD 1.5 million.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The CAIR is payable as an advance of the dividend tax credit mechanism; document the cost base carefully to avoid double counting with Line 2.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Eleven monthly installments already paid, withholding tax credits on interest and service income, and any prior CAIR tax paid in the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should ensure that all distributions in the year carried the mandatory dividend WHT; the associated tax is remitted by the S.A., not credited here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 - Tax payable or carryforward balance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final annual tax due after credits and prepayments, or the refundable/credit balance to be applied forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the balance by March 31; overpayments are recoverable but are routinely subject to DGI pre-refund audits in exporter structures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross dividends paid or credited to shareholders, including the 10% dividend withholding tax liability, on the return's dividend schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident shareholders, the 10% dividend tax is final; treaty-reduced rates require a valid tax residence certificate filed with the DGI before payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a monthly recargo of 5% of the tax due (capped at 50%), monthly moratory interest of 1%, and formal fines ranging from USD 25 to USD 10,000; understatement of gross income or improper export exemption claims carry penalties of 25% to 100% of the omitted tax plus 1% monthly interest.
